newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Light started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Light started as buy.

text.p: -- HSBC James Capel said it had started coverage of Brazilian power distributor Light Servicos de Eletricidade SA with a rating of buy.
-- "Six months have passed since Light was privatized and the company already looks different," analyst Luciana Portolano wrote in a Dec 9 report.

-- "The new controlling group is aggressively attempting to turn Light into one of the most profitable distributors in Brazil and reap the benefits of the excellent growth prospects in its concession area."
-- She added, "Since privatization the share price has been flat, but we believe that fourth quarter 1996 results will give the evidence of growth that the market has been waiting for."
-- The company's shares were off one to 325 reais in Sao Paulo.
